versions.changelog: SEO/AEO/GEO-optimized docs: richer features, FAQ, comparison table, geo/local section, accurate CLI quick-start; README badges. No code changes.

Major v2 upgrade: new reporting formats, trend analysis, and CI support.

- Added HTML reports with charts, SVG badge generation, CSV export, and CI/CD integration examples.
- Introduced git-aware codebase diffing, historical trend tracking, and snapshot features.
- Enhanced language detection coverage and built-in self-tests.
- Expanded CLI options for advanced analysis and export formats.
- Removed obsolete documentation (skill-card.md); updated and reorganized all docs.

- Initial release of codebase-inspection, a zero-dependency Python CLI tool.
- Analyzes any directory tree to report lines of code, language breakdowns, blank and comment lines, and file-type ratios.
- Supports JSON output for CI/CD integration and dashboards.
- Smartly skips common build and dependency directories.
- Recognizes 25+ languages by file extension.
- Cross-platform and works fully offline.
